goal: 面向公司领导与同事，用12页高管汇报解释Data Watch的建设背景、平台架构、四项创新、落地成效和下一步路线。

deck_context.source_summary: Data Watch是面向自动化码头的工业设备数据采集与监控平台。它把S7、GE SRTP、OPC UA、OPC DA等现场数据转换为统一数据流，支持中心式和分布式边缘部署，通过Redis承载实时态、TDengine保存时序历史、MySQL保存配置与权限，并通过Web、桌面App和CLI向业务用户、运维人员、脚本及AI Agent提供受控访问。
deck_context.core_claim: 先让分散的设备数据完整、持续、可信地流动，才可能实现真正的人机协同与智能运维。
deck_context.content_principle: 视觉优先，不把讲稿搬上页面。每页以一个图表、路径、架构、矩阵或核心隐喻承载逻辑，文字只做短标签和结论。不得虚构数据。

sample_generation_method.prompt_source: outline Slide 2 plus user-directed visual refinements; approved sample finalized through built-in image edit
sample_generation_method.input_context_preparation: Approved sample is available at the absolute workspace path and visible in the inherited conversation image context; use it as style reference only.
sample_generation_method.handoff_rule: Use built-in image_gen in generate mode for one slide. Match the approved sample's palette, typography, line language, whitespace and density; vary composition by slide role. Return a blocker if image_gen is unavailable.

style.name: 麦肯锡风格（样张适配版）
style.visual_direction: Premium strategy-consulting editorial slide design inspired by McKinsey/BCG/Bain rational clarity but not an official template. White or very pale cool-gray canvas, sharp Swiss grid, large whitespace, one dominant analytical mechanism, precise hairlines and restrained report metadata.
style.color_palette: White, off-white and very pale cool gray; ink blue-gray #243447 for text and structure; restrained steel-blue accent for one destination, key number or causal arrow; near-black for primary titles. No orange, neon, rainbow or large dark blocks.
style.typography: Modern highly legible Chinese sans-serif; bold but controlled main title aligned to a slim blue vertical rule; concise labels; compact English metadata; accurate Chinese characters; no long paragraphs.
style.texture_and_finish: Clean executive report with faint grid and subtle paper texture, vector-like diagrams, precise spacing and quiet shadows.
style.deck_consistency: Match the approved Slide 2 palette, typography mood, density, line weight, target markers and whitespace. Keep one coherent visual identity but vary layout and metaphor by page role.
style.content_density: Cover, key-message and conclusion slides are low density. Architecture, comparison and evidence slides are medium density. Never use generic rounded-card grids or text-heavy bullet pages.
style.universal_avoid: No real McKinsey logo, client logo, watermark, stock photography, clip art, people icons, robot avatars, decorative gradients, page numbers, invented statistics or unrelated labels.

approved_style_reference.fidelity: Match palette, typography mood, density, line language, whitespace and executive-report polish only; do not copy its exact layout or content.

slides.title: 两条部署路径，共用一套数据契约
slides.intent: 展示中心式与分布式两条数据路径，以及Redis、TDengine、MySQL和应用端的职责。
key_points: 中心式：PLC / OPC → Collector → Redis → Writer → TDengine
分布式：PLC / OPC → Collector → Edge Storage → SQLite outbox → Uploader → Ingest → Redis
slides.speaker_focus: 两条路径的差别在部署与交接位置，不在数据格式和质量语义。

local_context.required_background: Redis承担实时latest/window/stream/DLQ；Writer消费Stream并写TDengine；MySQL保存配置、权限、拓扑；CLI只经Backend访问。

layout.composition: 上半区为较短的中心式路径，下半区为带Edge Storage和SQLite outbox的分布式路径；两条路径在Redis处汇聚；右侧垂直分出Writer→TDengine和Backend→Web/App/CLI；MySQL作为控制面从下方连接Collector与Backend；一条细线“统一数据契约”贯穿两条路径。
layout.content_zones: title 15%, dual paths 55%, storage/application split 25%, implication 5%
layout.spacing: 中密度，模块不超过6个主视觉组，保证中文和英文模块名可读

visual_elements.main_visual: 上下双路径在Redis汇聚的系统架构
visual_elements.supporting_elements: 中心式 / 分布式标签，统一数据契约主轴，数据库圆柱线框，Web / App / CLI终端标签

constraints: 模块名与箭头方向必须准确
不使用Docker或云平台图标
不把MySQL画成时序数据存储

slides.title: 统一数据契约，屏蔽底层设备与协议差异

上层应用无需适配底层协议

local_context.required_background: 统一记录包含设备编号、点位标识、数值、时间、数据质量；质量码为Good、Uncertain、Bad。

layout.content_zones: title 17%, heterogeneous inputs 22%, contract boundary 25%, unified outputs 28%, takeaway 8%
layout.spacing: 中密度、一个核心转换机制、无卡片堆叠
